title: trifolium angustifolium subsp. intermedium
intro: Trifolium angustifolium subsp. intermedium, commonly known as the narrow-leaved red clover, is a plant species that belongs to the family Fabaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in treating various conditions such as wounds, digestive issues, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Trifolium angustifolium subsp. intermedium include wound healing, anti-cancer activity, and cardiovascular protection. The bioactive constituents of this plant include isoflavones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
